text:
tara singh: Quick sync: NovaBank wants a 10-day POC showing streaming NDJSON rows + function calls to their transaction API. They need a short SDK example, security assurances (SOC2, SAML, audit logs), and pricing for steady 50k tokens/day.
kevin park: For streaming we recommend one JSON object per message with a "type" field (row/tool_result/heartbeat). That avoids partial-array parsing issues. Example payload lines: {\"type\":\"row\",\"id\":1,\"payload\":{...}}
eva morris: If they insist on a single JSON array entry per event we can buffer until row complete, but that increases latency. Suggest NDJSON for UX.
tara singh: Can we show how tool calls correlate to rows? They want to ensure the balance lookup maps to the correct table row.
kevin park: We add a correlation id. Sequence: send row with id; emit tool_call event referencing id; emit tool_result with same id. Ordering preserved by stream.
eva morris: Security notes: Hosted demo can provide ephemeral keys, isolated project, and audit logs. BYOK and VPC require Private deployment (2-week lead). SAML needs metadata and ACS URL. We can provide SOC2 report.
infra-bot: create-env queued: novabank-demo (ETA 72h)
sam_sales: Procurement question: can you give hosted vs dedicated pricing ranges for 50k tokens/day over 3 months? They want to compare TCO quickly.
kevin park: Quick ballpark: hosted ~$0.003/token (discounts for volume), dedicated POC pool ~ $22k/mo base leading to ~30-45% lower effective token price depending on commit. I'll follow up with a spreadsheet.
tara singh: Action items: 1) Kevin: small Node + Python NDJSON snippet + correlation example (EOD). 2) Eva: 1-page security summary for SOW (tomorrow). 3) Sam: ask NovaBank for SAML metadata, sample dataset, and preferred POC start date. 4) Infra-bot: prep ephemeral keys when requested.
sam_sales: I'll request metadata and dataset now.
kevin park: Node snippet I'll paste in the SOW: const s = await Redwood.stream.connect({key:process.env.RW}); s.on('message', m => { const o = JSON.parse(m); if(o.type==='row') render(o.id,o.payload); if(o.type==='tool_result') attach(o.id,o.payload); }); // send tool call: s.send(JSON.stringify({type:'tool_call',id:7,name:'payments.lookup',args:{acct:'X'}}));
tara singh: Great. Keep updates here. If NovaBank asks for stricter JSON formatting we'll adapt but recommend NDJSON for progressive render. :thumbsup:
